 Gordon and Bellingham start
 Mourinho's Real trying to stop Barca's shot at history

BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at Camp Nou 
 Yan Diomande is playing with real confidence and assurance here. I don't think any Real fans are sat here wishing Vini Jnr was playing in his place at this stage.

 Post published at 20:27 GMT 20:27 GMT 
 Barcelona 0-0 Real Madrid 
 Image source, Getty Images Decent play by both sides just now. 
 First, Kylian Mbappe is away down the right, gets round his marker into the box but his attempted to cutback is intercepted. 
 Barcelona then break quickly as Anthony Gordon feeds Raphinha on the edge of the box but the ex-Leeds forward drives his shot wide.

 Barca win 2-1 with goals from Lamine and Pedri, Bellingham scores for Real and Mbappe misses a last minute sitter.

 Nice bit of skill by Fermín López as he lifts the ball over a couple of Real Madrid players but then ultimately loses possession.

 Elizabeth Conway 
BBC Sport Spanish football reporter at Camp Nou 
 Image source, Getty Images Cucurella is trying to get under Yamal's skin a bit here. They might be national teammates but there is nothing friendly about tonight. One of many individual battles going on. 
 53 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 20:21 GMT 20:21 GMT 
 Barcelona 0-0 Real Madrid 
 A good spell for Real Madrid as Yan Diomande spots Kylian Mbappe making a run down the left and plays the ball to him. Mbappe gets into the area but finds two Barcelona players on him. 
 Instead, the ball is worked to the other side of the area for Arda Güler, whose low strike is pushed away by Joan García.
